reasoning: The icon shows twin mountain peaks with an upward arrow, clearly evoking mountain climbing, elevation gain, or incline training, while also serving as the standard UI metaphor for uploading an image/landscape. It fits outdoor hiking, fitness incline workouts, and photo-uploading tasks well, though at very small sizes it could briefly resemble a rising stock chart.
